design_philosophy: Feminine, warm, Indian-inspired but modern. Celebratory yet calming. Architecturally precise but organically styled.

layout_and_spacing.bento_grid: Use React Native View with flexDirection: 'row', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 16 for bento layouts in Today tab.

navigation.details: To accommodate 7 tabs elegantly on mobile: Use a 5-item Bottom Tab Bar (Today, Planner, Fitness, Cycle, Menu). The 'Menu' tab opens a custom Bottom Sheet containing the remaining 3 tabs: Firm, Progress, Mind. This maintains 2026 UX best practices while including all 7 views without crowding the thumb zone.

floating_assistant.name: Meera
floating_assistant.description: Floating chat bubble accessible globally. Needs a subtle drop shadow and warm fuchsia/orange gradient border. Should remain persistent across all main screens.

celebration_animation.description: Marigold celebration burst when tasks/workouts are completed. If Lottie isn't immediately available, use react-native-reanimated for a custom scaling/fading orange/saffron particle effect.

cards.style: Flat solid surfaces. No glassmorphism (feels too clinical). Use solid #F4EBE6 or #FFFFFF with a 1px border of #2C2421 at 10% opacity. Subtle drop shadow (shadow-sm).

screens.Today: Bento grid layout. Includes: daily motivation quote (Fraunces font), cycle phase indicator, 3 priorities checklist, nutrition tip card, watch goals (steps/water/sleep).
screens.Planner: Monthly/Weekly calendar view. Clean, architectural grid.
screens.Fitness: 5-day PPL split (Mon Push, Tue Pull, Wed Legs, Thu Push, Fri Legs). Use horizontal scrolling cards for days with exact weights.
screens.Firm: Project pipeline (Warm Lead / Active / Cold Lead) for Stithi Architects. Kanban style horizontal swiping.
screens.Cycle: 32-day circular tracker. Highly visual, using SVG circular progress or segmented arcs representing (menstrual, follicular, ovulation, luteal).
screens.Progress: Graphs and body measurements. Use warm earthy tones for chart lines.
screens.Mind: Minimalist text input for brain dump. High negative space, distraction-free.

textures_and_backgrounds.description: Marigold macro texture for headers or Celebration overlay
Warm Chennai architecture, good for Firm tab background or header

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: This is a React Native Expo app. Do NOT use HTML elements (div, span). Use View, Text, TouchableOpacity, ScrollView.
Use NativeWind or StyleSheet for styling. Maps Tailwind classes provided in these guidelines to NativeWind.
Implement the Meera assistant as a floating absolute-positioned element across main screens.
Ensure all interactive elements have a `testID` attribute (e.g., testID='today-tab').
Avoid generic purple/blue gradients completely. Stick exclusively to the warm fuchsia, marigold, and earthy palette provided.
For typography, use Fraunces for headings (h1, h2) and Manrope for body text.

For the 7 tabs: implement a bottom navigation bar with 5 icons, and use a drawer/bottom sheet for the remaining 2, OR implement a horizontally scrollable tab bar if strict 7-tab flat hierarchy is mandatory.
